rites.name: Anavalsaira
rites.text: Anavalsaira is the concept of the first sounding in Ashiazis, the note that rang before the world's roots condensed out of the hum. It is not a being but the pattern by which early matter learned to hold its shape. Its signature is a long, resonant tone that binds scattered energy into stable form.

rites.name: Corellanum
rites.text: Corellanum is the resonant concept by which the Singing first gave shape to Ashiazis, a chord held before any roots had settled into stone. During the Age of Sundering it was the pattern that landfall tore apart and reassembled, leaving the world's bonds loose and singing.

rites.name: Isastith
rites.text: Isastith is a concept of Ashiazis, born in the Courts during the age of divine trials, when the first councils gathered to decide how the doors between worlds should be built. It is remembered as the principle that a threshold must be both earned and kept open. Its presence is felt as a quiet pressure that bends the oaths sworn before it.

rites.name: Kugournun
rites.text: Kugournun is the concept of the Quiet Powers, the sleeping forces that the makers of Ashiazis planted as the Weave during the Seeding. In the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke the old bonds, the concept was called upon to steady the shattered sky.

rites.name: Gogun
rites.text: Gogun is a concept of Ashiazis, the force that drew the Pact across the broken worlds of the Fall. It is remembered as the will that bound the Shards into a single oath.

rites.name: Lyarys
rites.text: Lyarys is the concept of the Pact sworn in Ashiazis after the Fall and the Sundering, when the broken worlds became Shards bound to the first sovereign's groves. It is the vow that growing kingdoms hold to in the Age of the first sovereign, and it is said to remember every promise made beneath the broken sky.

rites.name: Osivsiazith
rites.text: Osivsiazith is the concept of the Pact sworn in Ashiazis after the Fall, when the Shards drifted apart and the first sovereign bound the broken worlds to one oath. It is less a being than a binding idea, remembered by the groves and growing kingdoms as the reason their seasons still return.

rites.name: Peludath
rites.text: Peludath is the concept of walls that hold, the principle behind every barrier raised in Ashiazis during the Walled Age. Its orders and churches were said to remember each stone set by hand, and its first crossings marked the moment a wall was willingly opened.

rites.name: Osumameno
rites.text: Osumameno is a concept in Ashiazis, a binding idea that the walled orders of the Walled Age used to hold their stone holdings together. During the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke old bonds, the concept was carried across each new crossing as a sworn word. Its power lay less in force than in the oaths that refused to fail.

rites.name: Osyuzis
rites.text: Osyuzis is a sentient tide of luminous verdant radiation that pools in the crust of the world Ashiazis, and in its quiet phases it hums like a sleeping choir. When its reservoirs overfill, it erupts as a corona that can unmake a metropolis and its people in an instant, yet the same current quietly guides the slow ascent of new kinds of life. Those who channel it describe its will as patient, curious, and indifferent to any single species' survival.

rites.name: Osasora
rites.text: Osasora is a colossal orbital forge-engine that hangs between two dying suns in the Stellar realm of Ashiazis, turning captured starlight into the frozen hymns that bind its war-machines. Its gravitational lattice can fold a sun's corona into a single crushing pulse aimed at the lanes where enemy fleets gather.

rites.name: Syisteth
rites.text: Syisteth is a sphere of condensed starlight forged by the Ashiazis Stellar Choir, held in cupped hands and hurled to dissolve a foe in a flare of radiant decay. Its light is said to be the leftover song of a dying sun, and it burns only those whose hearts are truly hollow.

rites.name: Thyuthavsis
rites.text: Thyuthavsis is the concept of a branching ending within Ashiazis, a moment when the Three Futures diverge and the Library of the Stellar Realm must shelve each outcome as its own volume. It is less a being than a standing question that the Library answers by keeping every answer on a shelf.

rites.name: Zephithess
rites.text: Zephithess is a concept in Ashiazis that gathers the many possible endings of the Three Futures and shelves them so that no branch is lost. Born in the Age of Sundering, it gives form to the moment when landfall broke old bonds between the peoples of that world.
